name: Shred kit (agent-driven Blender paper-shred video template)
summary: Open-source Blender + Python template that renders an 8-second vertical (1080x1920, 60 fps) loop: your poster (text, fonts, colours, picture) is ripped, shredded and rebuilt as real paper in 3D, with a designed sound track. Ships an AGENTS.md playbook so Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can set it up, or use the kit.py CLI directly.

access.notes: Code GPL-3.0; bundled sound recordings public domain (Wikimedia Commons); videos you render are yours, commercial use included. Needs Blender 5.x, Python 3.10+, ffmpeg and a GPU (final render ~1h15 on RTX 4070 laptop).

procedure: git clone https://github.com/amirmushichge/shred-kit (or ask your coding agent to clone it and follow AGENTS.md)
python -m venv .venv && pip install -r requirements.txt, then python kit.py doctor
Set your lines/fonts/colours with python kit.py set ..., preview with kit.py poster and kit.py stills
python kit.py render --quality final --social; files land in out/

verdict.why: Primary repo from the author of the post, GPL-3.0 LICENSE and public-domain sound sources read, clear README and procedure. Young repo (1 day) but strong post traction (228 likes) and a complete, self-contained template.
